title: Performant ASR Models for Medical Entities in Accented Speech

bias_targets.methodology: Benchmarking 19 open-source and commercial ASR models on the AfriSpeech-200 dataset, which features 93 different African accents. Performance is evaluated specifically on the transcription of clinical named entities using metrics such as Word Error Rate (WER), Medical WER (M-WER), Medical Character Error Rate (M-CER), and Medical Named Entity Recall.
